title: CKD-bioMatch: A biomarker-targeted clinical trial to optimize treatment for patients with chronic kidney disease
official: A biomarker-targeted clinical trial to optimize treatment for patients with chronic kidney disease
summary: Main objective: To compare the effect of a biomarker-targeted treatment approach versus standard of care on chronic eGFR slope.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Age ≥ 18 and ≤ 75 years
2. UACR 100-5000 mg/g (11.3-565 mg/mmol) in two consecutive first-morning void urine samples. (UACR 80-100 mg/g is accepted if historical measurements are above 100 mg/g and if it cannot be explained by any new treatment.)
3. Stable treatment with maximum tolerated dose of an angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitor or angiotensin receptor blocker for at least four weeks prior to randomization. (Unless such treatment is contraindicated or not tolerated.)
4. Ability to communicate with the study staff and understand and sign the informed consent.
Exclusion criteria:
1. eGFR < 25 mL/min/1.73m2 at screening (FOR ITALY ONLY: eGFR < 30 and eGFR > 60 mL/min/1.73m2 at screening.)
2. Concomitant treatment with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors (e.g., itraconazole, ketoconazole, ritonavir, cobicistat, clarithromycin)
3. Treatment with a potassium-sparing diuretic or a mineralocorticoid receptor antagonist, except for finerenone (e.g., spironolactone, eplerenone, or amiloride)
4. Elevated Alanine Aminotransferase (ALT) > 3 x upper normal limit at screening, autoimmune hepatitis, and/or severe hepatic impairment (including but not limited to a history of hepatic encephalopathy, a history of esophageal varices or a history of portocaval shunt.)
5. Autosomal dominant or autosomal recessive polycystic kidney disease
6. Lupus nephritis or ANCA-associated vasculitis, or any other primary or secondary kidney disease requiring immunosuppressive therapy within 6 months prior to screening
7. Kidney transplant or dialysis
8. Known or suspected hypersensitivity to the study medications or related products
9. Presence or history of malignant neoplasms (except basal cell skin cancer or squamous cell skin cancer) within five years before screening.
10. Any other history, condition, therapy, or uncontrolled intercurrent illness that could, as judged by the investigator, affect participant safety or compliance with study requirements.
11. A female who is pregnant, breastfeeding, or intends to become pregnant, or women of childbearing potential (WOCBP) who are not using highly effective contraceptive methods.
12. Treatment with two or all of the three study drugs
13. Known or suspected abuse of narcotics
14. Participant in another intervention study.
15. Vulnerable (i.e. under guardianship) or mentally incapacitated subjects (i.e. not able to understand and sign the informed consent).
16. History of pancreatitis at screening
17. Body mass index < 18.5 kg/m2 at screening
18. Type 1 diabetes
19. Myocardial infarction, unstable angina, stroke, or transient ischemic attack within 12 weeks prior to enrolment
20. NYHA class IV Congestive Heart Failure at screening
21. Serum potassium > 5.0 mmol/L at screening
22. Addison’s Disease
